proposals.before: Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yong Guling.
proposals.after: Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum.
proposals.reason: 永固陵 is the Yonggu Mausoleum; 'Yong Guling' incorrectly splits the tomb name.

proposals.before: Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yong Guling.
proposals.after: Fourth month, on dingsi day, she was buried at Yonggu Mausoleum.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 永固陵 as in the idiomatic field.

proposals.before: Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun and the empress styled themselves Heavenly Primordial Emperor and Heavenly Primordial Empress.
proposals.after: Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun styled himself Heavenly Primordial Emperor and titled the empress Heavenly Primordial Empress.
proposals.reason: Chinese 帝后自稱天元皇帝，號后為天元皇后 means the emperor assumed the title and designated the empress; both did not style themselves emperor.

proposals.before: The emperor was greatly enraged and thereupon ordered the empress to die, forcing her to take farewell.
proposals.after: The emperor was greatly enraged and thereupon ordered the empress to die, forcing her to commit suicide.
proposals.reason: 逼令引訣 means forcing her to take her own life, not merely to take farewell.

decisions.reason: s0038 葬永固陵 names the tomb Yonggu Mausoleum as one word; 'Yong Guling' wrongly splits 永固 and 陵, and Yonggu Mausoleum is the accurate English rendering.
The literal field of s0038 has the same error for 永固陵; replacing 'Yong Guling' with Yonggu Mausoleum corrects the place name without inventing content.
s0076 pairs 自稱天元皇帝 with 號后為天元皇后: the emperor alone assumed the emperor title and then titled the empress; the original wrongly has both styling themselves.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 帝后自稱天元皇帝，號后為天元皇后

decisions.reason: s0093 逼令引訣 is the classical idiom for compelling suicide after 賜后死; 'take farewell' misreads 訣 and understates the forced self-killing.
